subject: general
question:
Parts of the given sentence have been given as options. One of them may contain a grammatical error. Select the option that has the error. If there is no error, select ‘No error’.

Specialists say that this method speeds up language learning tremendously.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "Specialists say that this method speeds up language learning tremendously" is **grammatically correct.**
 
• There are **no errors** in any part of the sentence.
 
• **Each component of the sentence follows the correct grammatical structure and syntax.**
 
• The use of "**speeds up"** correctly conveys the action performed by the method.
 
• The adverb "**tremendously**" is correctly placed to modify the verb phrase "speeds up language learning".

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• When analyzing sentences for grammatical errors, ensure that the subject-verb agreement is correct.
 
• Check the placement of adverbs to ensure they correctly modify the intended verbs or adjectives.
 
• Ensure that the sentence structure follows a logical order and that each component of the sentence serves its grammatical purpose.
